parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The default value is the current time. Both UNIX timestamps and time strings are supported. Time strings must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the EAIS instance.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The metric type. Valid values:

- GpuCoreUsage: GPU utilization

- GpuMemoryUsage: GPU memory utilization

- CpuCoreUsage: CPU utilization

- MemoryUsage: Memory utilization

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The default value is one hour before the current time. Both UNIX timestamps and time strings are supported. Time strings must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ format.

parameters.name: TimeStep
parameters.description:
The time step size. The default value is 5m. Valid units:

- h: hour

- m: minute

- s: second

If a unit is not specified, seconds (s) is used by default.
